invariants.rationale: The method returns a List, which is expected to be non-null as per typical contract and the use of 'collect(Collectors.toList())'.
partitionPath is a required argument to get slices and must be non-null to perform collection retrieval.
getFileId() should never return null, so all entries in the resulting List<String> are expected to be non-null.
The collected file ids are gathered with 'distinct()', so the result contains only unique elements.
The return type is a List, and 'collect(Collectors.toList())' guarantees an implementation of List.
